about: Quotes for the pain wall on the home page. Each quote is the speaker's own words, copied from the source. '…' marks words left out and [it] marks one word replaced; every entry in `checks` is an exact run of words on the source page, which scripts/check_pain_wall_links.py looks for. Roles only, never names. After editing, run: python3 scripts/build_pain_wall.py (writes the cards into index.html) and python3 scripts/check_pain_wall_links.py. `tone` is the card’s left stripe: amber (scams and impersonation), red (farmers beat real users), grey (people left out or burnt out); the order and tones follow the approved mock.
